title: de Gua's theorem: the 3D Pythagorean theorem

problemStatement.plain: AVAILABLE: Formalize de Gua's theorem — for a trirectangular tetrahedron the squared area of the face opposite the right-angle vertex equals the sum of squared areas of the three perpendicular faces (A₀²=A₁²+A₂²+A₃²).

proven: de Gua: squared area of hypotenuse face = sum of squared areas of the three right-angle faces (general orthogonal + axis-aligned forms)
knownResults.goal: Area(ABC)^2 = Area(OAB)^2 + Area(OBC)^2 + Area(OCA)^2 for a trirectangular tetrahedron
